info.syllabusName: Quản trị chất lượng (Total Quality Management)
info.description:
Chapter 1: The total quality approach to quality management: achieving organizational excellence

Chapter 2: Quality culture: changing hearts, Minds, and attitudes

Chapter 3: Overview of total quality tools

Chapter 4: Optimizing and controlling processes through statistical process control

Chapter 5: Problem solving and decision making

Chapter 6: Continual improvement methods with six sigma, lean, lean six sigma, and more

Chapter 7: Benchmarking

Chapter 8: Quality function deployment

Chapter 9: Implementing total quality management

Chapter 10: Iso 9000 and total quality: the relationship

Chapter 11: Quality management, ethics, and corporate social responsibility
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Define quality in terms of its historical perspective and its role in organisations today
Identify core principles of quality management and comment critically on their implications
Explain the significance of innovation for improving the competitive position of businesses and industries
Examine the role of process improvement as part of a continuous improvement culture
Analyze and critically assess alternative approaches to implementation of quality management principles and practices in organisations.
